svg.title: full-multi — Current six-Rollout topology with four persistent MariaDB StatefulSets
svg.desc: Editable architecture: one Istio ingress VirtualService delegates to Frontend Routers A/B. A/B Frontend and Backend use independent stable/canary workloads. CRUD A and CRUD B are separate BlueGreen Rollouts, each having distinct Blue active and Green preview Pods during the paused demo. Each CRUD Pod has a fixed DB_HOST to its dedicated MariaDB Blue or Green StatefulSet and isolated 4 GiB PVC. Frontend/Backend Canary and CRUD BlueGreen selections are independent HTTP header routing decisions.

text.font-family: Arial, Liberation Sans, DejaVu Sans, sans-serif
Arial, Liberation Sans, DejaVu Sans, sans-serif

svg.text: Istio delegation · Front/Backend Canary · CRUD BlueGreen · 4 persistent MariaDB StatefulSets
